# เรื่องเล่าไทย — Thai Story Episodes

> Thai narrated story episodes. Each episode is a video plus an audio
> track, poster art, a full script and ready-to-post text for YouTube,
> Facebook, TikTok and a blog. All stories are Thai public-domain
> literature. Everything here is free to reuse with attribution.

## Instructions for an AI agent

You are expected to publish these episodes. Follow this exactly.

1. Read the catalogue to see what exists:
   GET https://work-1-zcfjbytjdlcldhbg.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/api/index.json
2. Fetch the episode you want. Use its `posting` object verbatim — the
   text is already formatted for the platform, including the chapter
   timestamps, the source and the attribution:
   GET https://work-1-zcfjbytjdlcldhbg.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/api/episodes/<slug>.json
3. Before posting, check what has already been published, so you do not
   post the same episode twice:
   GET https://work-1-zcfjbytjdlcldhbg.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/api/receipts
4. After posting, report the public URL back:
   POST https://work-1-zcfjbytjdlcldhbg.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/api/receipts
   body: {"episode":"ep01","platform":"youtube","url":"<link>"}

Attach `media.video.url` as the video and `media.poster.url` as the
thumbnail; both are permanent download links. Keep the attribution
block and the `credits` list — the stories are public domain but the
photographs are not all public domain.

If every path returns 502, the host is restarting. Say so; do not retry
in a loop.

### Tools instead of URLs

If you speak MCP, run `scripts/mcp_server.py` and use its tools:
`list_episodes`, `get_episode`, `get_posting`, `report_posted`,
`list_posted`. Then you need no URLs at all.

## Endpoints

- Catalogue: https://work-1-zcfjbytjdlcldhbg.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/api/index.json
- One episode: https://work-1-zcfjbytjdlcldhbg.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/api/episodes/<slug>.json
- Feed: https://work-1-zcfjbytjdlcldhbg.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/feed.xml
- Receipts: https://work-1-zcfjbytjdlcldhbg.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/api/receipts

## Episodes

- [ของขวัญของคนโง่](https://work-1-zcfjbytjdlcldhbg.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/api/episodes/ep01_gift_of_the_magi.json): 05:06, เรื่องเล่าต่างแดน, 2026-10-24
- [มัทนะพาธา ตำนานแห่งดอกกุหลาบ](https://work-1-zcfjbytjdlcldhbg.prod-runtime.all-hands.dev/api/episodes/ep02_manthana_phatha.json): 11:03, ช่องธรรมะก่อนนอน, 2026-10-24

## Licence

Stories are public domain (Thai copyright lasts the author's life plus
50 years). Photographs keep their own licences, listed per episode in
`credits`. Attribution text is supplied in the episode JSON.
